proposal.metadata: Migrate control of Juno liquidity in Prop 61
proposal.title: Migrate control of Juno liquidity in Prop 61
proposal.summary:
Summary:

Migrate control of the 1 million Juno in  Proposal 61 “Sunset Liquidity Incentives for JunoSwap” (https://www.mintscan.io/juno/proposals/61) to the newly formed liquidity subdao within the operations department. 

Rationale:

Part of this agreement when the proposal passed was that the “funds would stay in the multisig until new direction from the community and waiting for other DEX protocols to deploy”. With the recent development of the Juno Charter and the newly formed multisig group formed within the operations department. Migrating control of these assets to the liquidity subdao under the operations department would put control back in the hands of the community 


Current Multisig Members Responsible for Execution:

Jake Hartnell 

The Frey 

Dimi 


Voting Options

Vote YES if you are in favor of migrating control of the liquidity.

Vote NO if you oppose migrating control of the liquidity.

Vote ABSTAIN if you have no preference on this matter.

Vote VETO if you believe this proposal to be inappropriate or detrimental to the community.

We appreciate your participation and thoughtful consideration of this proposal.
